title: picture/track/v1
description: The members picture-ws adds to a track/telemetry/v1 frame (uspace-lab schemas/common/track/telemetry/v1, M29; WP-13): age_s, now - captured_at on this system's clock when the frame was sent, and source_state, the state of the track's source instance (source/status/v1's). The envelope is the producer's, so every track keeps its own times. operator_position, the remote pilot or operator position a Display Provider flight carries (WP-14), is shown to the console realm only and omitted for every other realm and any public subset (spec 06 §5). A track frame validates against the lab's track/telemetry/v1 and against this schema.
